proposal.expected_benefit: This will help identify potential gaps in the defense strategy and ensure that the mitigations are effective in diverse and unpredictable environments.
proposal.problem: The defense strategy is robust in a simulated environment but may not be fully prepared for real-world adversarial scenarios due to the lack of real-world testing.
proposal.proposed_change: Integrate real-world adversarial testing into the training curriculum to expose the defense mechanisms to evolving attack vectors and real-world conditions.
proposal.title: Enhance Real-World Simulation Testing
